title: Crispy Parmesan-Crusted Chicken
creator: Ray Finds
cookTime: About 20 minutes at 400°F, until chicken reaches 165°F inside
ingredients: 6 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (thin or pounded even)
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Heat the oven to 400°F.
Roll each chicken breast in the shredded parmesan and press it on so it sticks all over.
Lay the chicken on the tray.
Drizzle a little olive oil over the top.
Bake for about 20 minutes, until golden and crispy and the chicken is cooked through (165°F inside).
notes: From a Ray Finds Facebook reel (labeled AI content; the video appears AI-generated). Recipe from the reel caption: no flour, no breadcrumbs, no frying. Several commenters doubted 20 minutes is enough for full chicken breasts, so use thin or pounded breasts and check for 165°F inside, baking longer if needed. One commenter asked about coating the chicken with olive oil before the parmesan; the caption drizzles it on top instead. Not stated: servings and prep time.
